sentences.en: Hi
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Great to see you!
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你们！

sentences.en: I'm Jody, and I'll be looking after both of you for the first month you're working here at the Amersham Theatre
sentences.zh: 我是乔迪，接下来的一个月，我将负责照应你们两位在阿默舍姆剧院的工作。

sentences.en: 'll tell you something about the theatre now, then take you to meet two of the other staff
sentences.zh: 现在我先向你们介绍一下剧院的情况，然后带你们去见两位其他员工。

sentences.en: It's an old building, and it's been modernised several times
sentences.zh: 这是一座老建筑，曾多次进行现代化改造。

sentences.en: In fact, as you can see, we're carrying out a major refurbishment at the moment
sentences.zh: 事实上，正如你们所见，我们目前正在开展一项大规模的翻新工程。

sentences.en: The interior has just been repainted, and we're about to start on the exterior of the building - that'll be a big job
sentences.zh: 内部刚刚重新粉刷完毕，而建筑外部的翻新工作即将开始——这将是一项大工程。

sentences.en: The work's running over budget, so we've had to postpone installing an elevator
sentences.zh: 工程已超出预算，因此我们不得不推迟安装电梯。

sentences.en: I hope you're happy running up and down stairs!
sentences.zh: 希望你们不介意上下楼梯！

sentences.en: When the theatre was built. people were generally slimmer and shorter than now. and the seats were very close together
sentences.zh: 剧院建造时，人们的体型普遍比现在更瘦小，座椅之间的间距也非常紧凑。

sentences.en: We've replaced them with larger seats., with more legroom
sentences.zh: 我们已将其更换为更大的座椅，并增加了腿部空间。

sentences.en: This means fewer seats in total, but we've taken the opportunity to install seats that can easily be moved, to create different acting spaces
sentences.zh: 这意味着总座位数有所减少，但我们借此机会安装了可轻松移动的座椅，以便灵活打造不同的表演空间。

sentences.en: We've also turned a few storerooms over to other purposes, like using them for meetings
sentences.zh: 我们还把几间原为音效脚本储藏室的房间改作他用，例如用于召开会议。

sentences.en: We try hard to involve members of the public in the theatre
sentences.zh: 我们努力让公众积极参与剧院的各项活动。

sentences.en: One way is by organising backstage tours, so people can be shown round the building and learn how a theatre operates
sentences.zh: 其中一种方式是组织后台参观活动，带领人们参观整栋建筑，并了解剧院的日常运营。

sentences.en: These are proving very popular
sentences.zh: 这些参观活动目前非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: What we're finding is that people want to have lunch or a cup of coffee while they're here, so we're looking into the possibility of opening a café in due course
sentences.zh: 我们发现，人们希望在此逗留期间享用午餐或喝杯咖啡，因此我们正在考虑适时开设一家咖啡馆。

sentences.en: We have a bookshop, which specialises in books about drama, and that attracts plenty of customers
sentences.zh: 我们有一家书店，专营戏剧类图书，这吸引了大量顾客。

sentences.en: Then there are two large rooms that will be decorated next month, and they'll be available for hire, for conferences and private functions, such as parties
sentences.zh: 此外还有两间大房间将于下月完成装修，之后将对外出租，用于举办会议及私人活动（如聚会）。

sentences.en: We're also considering hiring out costumes to amateur drama clubs
sentences.zh: 我们还在考虑将戏服租借给业余戏剧社团。

sentences.en: Now I want to tell you about our workshops
sentences.zh: 接下来，我想向你们介绍一下我们的工作坊。

sentences.en: We recently started a programme of workshops that anyone can join
sentences.zh: 我们最近启动了一项面向所有人的工作坊计划。

sentences.en: Eventually we intend to run courses in acting, but we're waiting until we've got the right people in place as trainers
sentences.zh: 最终我们计划开设表演课程，但需先配备合适的培训师，目前正为此做准备。

sentences.en: That's proving more difficult than we'd expected!
sentences.zh: 这比我们预想的要困难得多！

sentences.en: There's a big demand to learn about the technical side of putting on a production, and our lighting workshop has already started, with great success
sentences.zh: 公众对学习舞台制作的技术环节有强烈需求，我们的灯光工作坊已顺利开班，反响极佳。

sentences.en: We're going to start one on sound next month
sentences.zh: 下个月我们将启动一个音响工作坊。

sentences.en: A number of people have enquired about workshops on make-up, and that's something we're considering for the future
sentences.zh: 不少人咨询过化妆工作坊的相关事宜，这也是我们未来考虑的方向之一。

sentences.en: A surprise success is the workshop on making puppets - we happen to have someone working here who does it as a hobby, and she offered to run a workshop
sentences.zh: 出人意料的成功案例是木偶制作工作坊——碰巧我们这里有一位员工将此作为业余爱好，她主动提出开设工作坊。

sentences.en: It was so popular we're now running them every month!
sentences.zh: 该工作坊人气极高，如今我们已每月定期举办！

sentences.en: Now, a word about the layout of the building
sentences.zh: 现在，简单说明一下建筑的布局。

sentences.en: The auditorium, stage and dressing rooms for the actors are all below ground level
sentences.zh: 观众席、舞台以及演员化妆间均位于地下层。

sentences.en: Here on the ground floor we have most of the rooms that the public doesn't see
sentences.zh: 地面层则集中了大部分公众无法进入的房间。

sentences.en: The majority are internal, so they have windows in the roof to light them
sentences.zh: 多数房间为内设型，因此顶部设有天窗以提供采光。

sentences.en: Standing here in the foyer, you're probably wondering why the box office isn't here, where the public would expect to find it
sentences.zh: 此刻你们站在门厅中，或许会疑惑：为什么售票处不设在此处？毕竟公众通常会预期在这里找到它。

sentences.en: Well, you might have noticed it on it your way in although it's
sentences.zh: 其实，你们进门时可能已经注意到了，尽管它属于本建筑的一部分，

sentences.en: part of this building, it's next door, with a separate entrance from the road
sentences.zh: 但它实际位于隔壁，拥有独立的临街入口。

sentences.en: For the theatre manager's office, you go across the foyer and through the double doors, turn right, and it's the room at the end of the corridor, with the door on the left
sentences.zh: 剧院经理办公室位于穿过门厅、经过双开门后右转，再沿走廊走到尽头，左侧的那间房就是。

sentences.en: The lighting box is where the computerised stage lighting is operated, and it's at the back of the building
sentences.zh: 灯光控制室是操作电脑化舞台灯光的地方，位于建筑后部。

sentences.en: When you're through the double doors, turn left, turn right at the water cooler, and right again at the end
sentences.zh: 穿过双开门后左转，到饮水机处右转，再于走廊尽头再次右转。

sentences.en: It's the second room along that corridor
sentences.zh: 沿着这条走廊，第二间房便是。

sentences.en: The lighting box has a window into the auditorium, which of course is below us
sentences.zh: 灯光控制箱有一个朝向观众席的窗口，而观众席当然在我们下方。

sentences.en: The artistic director's office is through the double doors, turn right, and it's the first room you come to on the right-hand side
sentences.zh: 艺术总监的办公室在那扇双开门后面，右转，右边第一个房间就是。

sentences.en: And finally, for the moment, the room where I'll take you next the relaxation room
sentences.zh: 最后，目前我要带您去的是放松室。

sentences.en: So if you'd like to come with me
sentences.zh: 那么，请跟我来。
